sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Cubic Cubic are simple yet challenging. The game takes place on a 3D grid, where you control a cube that can move left, right, up, and down. Your goal is to navigate the cube through increasingly difficult levels, collecting points and trying to reach the bonus level. The game gets progressively harder as you progress, with new obstacles and challenges appearing on each level. To move the cube, you can use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it easy to play on any device.

The game has different types of levels, including straight levels, levels with obstacles, and levels with power-ups. The straight levels are the easiest, where you just need to navigate the cube through the level without any obstacles. The levels with obstacles are more challenging, where you need to avoid obstacles like walls, spikes, and moving blocks. The levels with power-ups are the most challenging, where you need to collect power-ups to increase your score and reach the bonus level.

As you progress through the levels, you'll discover new power-ups and obstacles that will make the game even more challenging and exciting. The game also has a scoring system, where you earn points for collecting power-ups and reaching the bonus level.
